notes.title: playable secret character
notes.content:
I finally finished this update, a new secret character has been added! to release it, just finish the game once it will appear on the character selection screen !.




I'm developing "Revenge On The Streets 3 the last fight" this is going to be more work to finish it! but I intend to release it later this year or at the beginning of the next one, in short, this third game will be the last of this Beat up franchise! I will focus on other new titles!
